item.text: Bath asparagus (*Ornithogalum pyrenaicum*) is also known as Prussian asparagus, wild asparagus, and Pyrenees or spiked star of Bethlehem. Its young flower shoots can be eaten as an asparagus-like vegetable. The name “Bath asparagus” reflects its former abundance near Bath, England.
